QuakeWorld Duel League is a division based league, with regular seasons followed by playoffs. Old or new, master or rookie, the experience will fulfil your needs. Season games are quick, {{Abbr|GO3|Game of 3}}, to allow players with a tight schedule to participate. 

Season 1 saw 90 players battling across continents - Europe bolstering 3 divisions, also {{Flag/us}} North America aswell as {{Flag/au}} Australia have one division each.
